# Externally sourced evaluation corpus

This directory is intentionally empty of claimed real-world labels until each fixture has auditable provenance.

A fixture must record:

- package ecosystem and registry;
- package/version or import reference;
- expected state and label source;
- source URL and retrieval date;
- inclusion rationale;
- license/redistribution constraints;
- expected evidence and unresolved status.

Do not add a package to accuracy metrics when its label is uncertain. Use `status: unresolved` and report it as an exclusion instead.
